description: The 568 Frankish and eastern ruler agendas and starts name the people, places and pressures of their courts instead of listing what each review does not do. Ids, operations, years and seasons are unchanged.

changes.before:
title:'Sigebert: the living Austrasian court',intro:'Review the actual household, holdings and neighbors. These decisions grant no new land, kin or military order.',stages:[
      {id:'si_court',name:'The living court',year:568,season:0,text:'Review your present household. Brunhild may share its concerns while she lives, and the court can change.',choices:[
        {id:'si_attend_court',label:'Prioritize the living household',detail:'Record attention without moving, marrying or creating anyone.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_court',label:'Retain present arrangements',detail:'Leave the household as it is.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_partition',name:'Holdings after the division',year:568,season:0,text:'Review the counties you actually govern, including the current Tours and Poitiers holdings. Paris remains represented by one owner on this map.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_holdings',label:'Prioritize current holdings',detail:'Record a priority without acquiring a city or claim.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_holdings',label:'Retain present governance',detail:'Leave ownership and revenue unchanged.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_neighbors',name:'Neighboring courts',year:568,season:1,text:'Consult the living neighboring courts before choosing a diplomatic course. Family history grants no treaty.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_neighbors',label:'Prioritize ordinary diplomacy',detail:'Record interest without an agreement, access or payment.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_neighbors',label:'Retain current relations',detail:'Make no diplomatic commitment.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_resources',name:'Resources and obligations',year:568,season:1,text:'Review actual funds, forces and obligations before making another commitment.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_resources',label:'Prioritize affordable preparation',detail:'Raise no host and spend no funds.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_resources',label:'Retain current commitments',detail:'Keep the existing accounts and orders.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_future',name:'The court ahead',year:568,season:2,text:'Consider the living family and ordinary succession options. This review names no future heir.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_future',label:'Prioritize continuity',detail:'Record a preference without creating or designating an heir.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_future',label:'Leave plans open',detail:'Complete these reviews with the actual court.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]}
changes.after:
title:'Sigebert: the living Austrasian court',intro:'You rule Austrasia from Metz in 568, with Brunhild newly at your side and your brothers Chilperic and Guntram as neighbors. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',stages:[
      {id:'si_court',name:'Brunhild at Metz',year:568,season:0,text:'Brunhild, the Visigothic princess you married last year, now keeps court with you at Metz.',choices:[
        {id:'si_attend_court',label:'Put Brunhild and the court first',detail:'The household at Metz takes your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_court',label:'Leave the household to run itself',detail:'You turn from the household to the business of rule.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_partition',name:'Charibert’s share',year:568,season:0,text:'Charibert’s death last year added Tours and Poitiers to your lands, far west of Metz and close to Chilperic’s.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_holdings',label:'Look to Tours and Poitiers',detail:'Your attention turns west to the cities you gained from Charibert.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_holdings',label:'Govern from Metz as before',detail:'The heartland around Metz and Reims stays your first concern.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_neighbors',name:'Brothers and neighbors',year:568,season:1,text:'Chilperic at Soissons and Guntram at Orleans share the Frankish lands with you, and the Avars beyond your eastern frontier remain a threat.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_neighbors',label:'Keep the peace with your brothers',detail:'Envoys to Soissons and Orleans take priority this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_neighbors',label:'Watch your brothers and the Avars',detail:'You keep your own counsel and watch every border.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_resources',name:'Treasury and warriors',year:568,season:1,text:'Brunhild’s dowry and the revenues of your cities must carry the court before any campaign.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_resources',label:'Build up the treasury first',detail:'Thrift and preparation guide the court this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_resources',label:'Keep faith with your followers',detail:'Gifts and promises to your warriors come before savings.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'si_future',name:'The court ahead',year:568,season:2,text:'The future of the Austrasian line rests on your marriage to Brunhild and on the loyalty of your great men.',choices:[
        {id:'si_review_future',label:'Secure the line through Brunhild',detail:'The court’s hopes turn to an heir from your marriage.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'si_keep_future',label:'Leave the succession in God’s hands',detail:'You close these reviews with the court as it stands.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]}

title:'Chilperic: the Soissons court',intro:'You rule Neustria from Soissons in 568, the youngest of Chlothar’s sons and the most eager for more of the Frankish lands. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',stages:[
      {id:'ch_court',name:'A court without a queen',year:568,season:0,text:'Sigebert’s marriage to Brunhild has raised his court above yours, and your own household at Soissons has no queen.',choices:[
        {id:'ch_review_court',label:'Seek a royal bride to rival Brunhild',detail:'Finding a royal bride becomes your court’s first concern.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ch_keep_court',label:'Keep your household as it is',detail:'You leave marriage plans aside for now.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ch_partition',name:'Paris and Charibert’s lands',year:568,season:0,text:'Charibert’s death last year left his lands to be shared, and Paris is in your hands while your brothers watch your share closely.',choices:[
        {id:'ch_review_holdings',label:'Tighten your grip on Paris',detail:'Paris and Rouen take your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ch_keep_holdings',label:'Govern from Soissons as before',detail:'The old lands around Soissons stay your first concern.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ch_family_context',name:'Brothers and rivals',year:568,season:1,text:'Sigebert at Metz and Guntram at Orleans border your lands, and your old quarrel with Sigebert could flare at any time.',choices:[
        {id:'ch_review_relations',label:'Keep the peace with Sigebert',detail:'Envoys to Metz and Orleans take priority this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ch_keep_relations',label:'Press your brothers for advantage',detail:'Your court looks for any opening against Sigebert.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ch_resources',name:'Treasury and warriors',year:568,season:1,text:'Your treasury and warriors must carry any plan you make against your brothers.',choices:[
        {id:'ch_review_resources',label:'Fill the treasury before acting',detail:'Thrift and patience guide the court this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ch_keep_resources',label:'Keep your warriors well rewarded',detail:'Gifts to your followers come before savings.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ch_future',name:'Your heirs',year:568,season:2,text:'Who follows you at Soissons depends on the marriage you make and the sons it brings.',choices:[
        {id:'ch_review_future',label:'Plan for an heir at Soissons',detail:'The court’s hopes turn to a son who can keep your share.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ch_keep_future',label:'Leave the succession open',detail:'You close these reviews with the court as it stands.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]}

title:'Guntram: Orleans and Burgundy',intro:'You rule Orleans and Burgundy in 568, from the Loire to the Rhône, with the Lombards stirring beyond the Alps. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',stages:[
      {id:'gu_court',name:'The court at Orleans',year:568,season:0,text:'Your household at Orleans is small, and the question of an heir weighs on you.',choices:[
        {id:'gu_review_court',label:'Put the household and an heir first',detail:'Marriage and an heir become the court’s first concern.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'gu_keep_court',label:'Keep the household as it is',detail:'You leave household matters aside for now.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'gu_inheritance',name:'From the Loire to the Rhône',year:568,season:0,text:'Your share runs from Orleans on the Loire down the Rhône to Lyon, Arles and Marseille.',choices:[
        {id:'gu_review_holdings',label:'Look to the Rhône cities',detail:'Lyon, Arles and Marseille take your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'gu_keep_holdings',label:'Govern from Orleans as before',detail:'The Loire lands around Orleans stay your first concern.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'gu_neighbors',name:'Between your brothers',year:568,season:1,text:'Sigebert at Metz and Chilperic at Soissons eye each other across your borders, and either may ask you to judge between them.',choices:[
        {id:'gu_review_neighbors',label:'Mediate between Sigebert and Chilperic',detail:'Envoys to Metz and Soissons take priority this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'gu_keep_neighbors',label:'Stay out of your brothers’ quarrels',detail:'You keep your own counsel and guard your own lands.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'gu_resources',name:'The Alpine frontier',year:568,season:1,text:'The Lombards on the far side of the Alps could one day cross the passes into Provence, and your treasury must cover its defense.',choices:[
        {id:'gu_review_resources',label:'Put the defense of Provence first',detail:'Your attention turns to the Alpine passes and the Rhône cities.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'gu_keep_resources',label:'Keep your obligations at home',detail:'Promises to your followers along the Loire come first.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'gu_future',name:'The court continues',year:568,season:2,text:'With no heir secure, who will follow you at Orleans is still an open question.',choices:[
        {id:'gu_review_future',label:'Seek an heir for Burgundy',detail:'The court’s hopes turn to a son of your own.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'gu_keep_future',label:'Leave the succession open',detail:'You close these reviews with the court as it stands.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]}

title:'Justin: the eastern court',intro:'You rule from Constantinople in 568, with Narses commanding in Italy and the fifty-year peace with Persia to uphold. These priorities shape your court’s story; orders, payments and wars go through Rank & Realm, Land and the map.',stages:[
      {id:'ji_court',name:'The palace',year:568,season:0,text:'You have ruled from the Great Palace since 565, and its officials already compete for your favor.',choices:[
        {id:'ji_review_court',label:'Put the palace and its officials first',detail:'Appointments and favor at court take your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_keep_court',label:'Leave the palace to its officials',detail:'You turn from court affairs to the provinces.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ji_italy',name:'Commands in Italy',year:568,season:0,text:'Narses still commands in Italy while voices at court press for his recall.',choices:[
        {id:'ji_review_italy',label:'Weigh the recall of Narses',detail:'The future of the Italian command takes your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_keep_italy',label:'Keep Narses in his command',detail:'You stand by Narses and his officers in Italy.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ji_north',name:'Northern Italy',year:568,season:1,text:'Alboin’s Lombards in Pannonia are restless, and Verona and Pavia lie on their road into Italy.',choices:[
        {id:'ji_review_defense',label:'Strengthen the northern Italian garrisons',detail:'The defense of Verona and Pavia takes priority this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_review_diplomacy',label:'Seek terms with the Lombards',detail:'Your envoys turn to Alboin and his court in Pannonia.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_keep_north',label:'Trust the garrisons as they stand',detail:'You leave northern Italy to its commanders.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ji_east',name:'Eastern approaches',year:569,season:0,text:'Reports reach you of the Turks beyond Persia, eager to sell silk in Constantinople and to find an ally against Khosrow.',choices:[
        {id:'ji_review_east',label:'Court the Turks against Persia',detail:'An alliance in the east takes your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_keep_east',label:'Keep the peace with Khosrow',detail:'You hold to the fifty-year peace and its terms.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ji_armenia',name:'The Armenian frontier',year:571,season:0,text:'Armenians under Persian rule chafe at Khosrow’s governors, and some look to Constantinople for help.',choices:[
        {id:'ji_review_armenia',label:'Support the Armenians against Persia',detail:'The Armenian cause takes your attention this season.',operation:'agenda_priority'},
        {id:'ji_keep_armenia',label:'Leave Persian Armenia to Khosrow',detail:'You stay out of Persian Armenia and its quarrels.',operation:'agenda_priority'}]},
      {id:'ji_future',name:'Peace or war with Persia',year:572,season:0,text:'The peace with Persia rests on yearly Roman payments, and voices at court say Rome should pay no longer.',choices:[
